**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User has experience with lavender in baking.  
[FACT] User made a lemon lavender cake two weeks ago for a friend's birthday party.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for a recipe for lavender shortbread cookies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Lavender and shortbread are a good pairing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Provided a recipe for Lavender Shortbread Cookies, including ingredients and instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Ingredients for Lavender Shortbread Cookies: 1 1/2 sticks (6 tablespoons) unsalted butter, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 2 tablespoons lavender syrup or 1 teaspoon dried lavender buds, 2 1/4 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 teaspoon salt.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Instructions for Lavender Shortbread Cookies include preheating the oven to 300°F (150°C), creaming butter and sugar, adding lavender, mixing dry ingredients, refrigerating dough, rolling out, cutting shapes, baking for 18-20 minutes, and cooling.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Notes on making lavender syrup and using dried lavender buds were provided.  
[PREFERENCE] User is considering substituting granulated sugar with turbinado sugar.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Turbinado sugar can be substituted for granulated sugar in the recipe.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Using turbinado sugar may affect flavor and texture: it has a coarser texture and a more caramel-like flavor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for using turbinado sugar include creaming the butter and sugar longer and monitoring baking time for browning.  
[PREFERENCE] User plans to try the recipe with turbinado sugar.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in adjusting baking time for smaller cookies (1 inch in diameter).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smaller cookies will bake faster; recommended baking time is 12-14 minutes for 1-inch cookies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General guidelines for baking times based on cookie size were provided.  
[PREFERENCE] User is using a new brand of lavender extract from a local gourmet store.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for lavender extract brands include Les Vergers de Valensole, L'Occitane, Moulins de la Brune, Heilala Vanilla, Frontier Co-op, and Monin Lavender Syrup.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested trying different types of lavender for unique flavor profiles.
